scope: Pure N=1, N=2, and N=4 super Yang-Mills in Lorentzian and Euclidean signatures, in N=1 superspace and components, including supersymmetry closure and Noether currents

proof_obligations.reason: Within the declared linear invertible doublet/triplet ansatz, the manifest gaugino slots require gamma c=-i s while the symmetric auxiliary derivative slots require gamma c=+i s for invertible s; nonlinear or field-dependent alternatives are outside this gate.

proof_obligations.scope: componentwise SU(2)_R-covariant rewriting only; on-shell algebra closure is not claimed

resolved_findings.issue: N1 initially lacked the Euclidean Euler and current-divergence surface.
resolved_findings.resolution: Added the compact Euclidean density, Euler operators, Bianchi reduction, and both current divergences.

resolved_findings.issue: N2 initially asserted relative-metric equations and Noether reduction without the generating monomials.
resolved_findings.resolution: Displayed the linear closure monomial, both kinetic cancellation monomials, the complete product-rule divergence, and its sigma, Bianchi, trace, and Jacobi reductions.

resolved_findings.issue: N4 initially defined boundary coefficients through the desired current and skipped the fermion EOM reduction.
resolved_findings.resolution: Derived all four boundary coefficients sector by sector and added the two-chirality closure reduction ledger plus exact coefficient checks.
